description: This file defines a helper class for handling data validation types, error styles, and operators within the context of reading Excel files in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes mappings from integer codes to their string representations and static methods to retrieve these representations.

classes.name: DataValidationHelper
classes.description: Provides static helper methods for converting data validation codes to their string representations, used during parsing of XLS files within PhpSpreadsheet.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a data validation type code, or null if unrecognized.

methods.name: errorStyle
methods.description: Returns the string representation of an error style code, or null if unrecognized.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the string representation of an operator code, or null if unrecognized.
